VISUAL DRAFT — NOT A CERTIFIED PHYSICAL TRACK PACK
Part identities and catalogue dimensions are sourced. Widths, radii, rail spacing and border decoration use provisional drawing parameters.
Flat pieces only in this first study. End caps, control units, lane changers, pit lanes and banking need separate measured geometry.
